title: res-asset-kpi: key performance indicators for operating PV, wind and battery assets
description:
A Python library of key performance indicators for operating renewable assets: performance ratio, temperature-corrected and weather-corrected PR, availability and a budget-to-actual energy bridge for PV plants; availability by IEC 61400-26 categories, power curves by the method of bins and reliability indicators (MTBF, MTTR, Crow-AMSAA) for wind turbines; state-of-charge-corrected round-trip efficiency, LTSA availability, rainflow cycles and capacity tests with uncertainty for battery storage; and contract guarantees and liquidated damages in YAML.

Implemented from public descriptions of the standards; not a certified implementation. Documentation: https://kwwaleszczynski-del.github.io/res-asset-kpi/
